name: com.tencent.klevin.download.apkdownloader.view.ComplianceActivity
description: Before a Klevin ad's APK is downloaded, this page shows the advertised app's name, publisher, version, update date, and icon, links to permission and privacy details, and offers to start the download.
disableEffect: The Klevin download disclosure and consent screen will not appear, so this download flow cannot continue through it.
